certificate.question: Do I need an electronic signing certificate?
certificate.answer: Yes, and that is an SRI requirement, not ours. Comprobify does not issue or generate signing certificates: you must obtain your .p12 file from an accredited certification authority in Ecuador. Once you have it, you upload it to Comprobify and we sign your documents with it. We also notify you by email and in the app when it is about to expire.

testing.question: Can I test before issuing for real?
testing.answer: Yes. Every company has a test copy that issues against the SRI test environment, with no tax validity, and does not use your quota. When you are ready you go live from the app: your customers, products and templates are copied to the real company; the test documents stay in the test copy.

payment.question: How do I pay for the subscription?
payment.answer: You can pay by bank transfer or by card. With a transfer we show you the account details, you make the payment and upload the receipt; with a card you pay on the spot. Your plan activates as soon as the payment is verified. You can change plan, add modules or buy document packs whenever you want; before you confirm, the Plan section shows what will be charged.

sequentials.question: I already invoice in another system. Do I lose my numbering?
sequentials.answer: No. You can set the next sequential per document type and per branch, so you continue exactly where you left off without duplicating numbers.

modules.question: Is it only for invoicing?
modules.answer: No. Besides invoices, credit notes and delivery guides, you can add inventory, purchase and sale orders, bulk invoicing and advanced reports. Each plan includes some modules and the rest are added separately; the pricing page shows it all.

authorization.question: How do I know the SRI authorized my document?
authorization.answer: Comprobify sends the document, checks the authorization and notifies you when the status changes, in the app and by email. From the document itself you download the authorized XML and the RIDE PDF.
